from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitationInfo(BaseModel):
    """For each provided paper, track its title and its citation relationships within the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper references (outgoing)")
    cited_by_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper (incoming)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperCitationInfo]
